# Numerical references

Generated by `tools/make_reference.R` from an installed ade4 package. `VERSION`
records the R and ade4 versions. Synthetic inputs are defined in that script.
`woangers_input.tsv` contains the trait table from ade4's `woangers` dataset,
the 80-species case study in Pavoine et al. (2009). No local unpublished data
are included. Dataset provenance and documentation:
<https://adeverse.github.io/ade4/reference/woangers.html>.

`*_global.tsv` stores symmetric mixed-distance matrices. `*_traits.tsv` stores
one trait per column, with unordered pairs in R `dist` order (lower triangle,
column by column). `*_sq_*` and `*_raw_*` store the output of `kdist.cor` with
squared and unsquared distances, respectively. Unavailable entries are `NaN`.

The fixture generator calls ade4's public functions directly. For nondefault
metrics it supplies answers to the interactive prompts in a temporary function
environment without modifying the installed package or its formulas.
